headline: Wade beats Klinge to win the Australian Darts Masters
standfirst: James Wade won the World Series event in Wollongong, beating Australia's Brody Klinge 8-5 even though Klinge averaged 104.56 in the final.
body: James Wade won the Australian Darts Masters at the WIN Entertainment Centre in Wollongong, beating Brody Klinge 8-5 in the final. Klinge had the higher average, 104.56 to Wade's 101.62, but Wade took his chances to win the title.
Wade opened with a 6-0 whitewash of Tim Pusey and then edged Stephen Bunting 6-5 in the quarter-finals, hitting a 164 checkout. He beat Gerwyn Price 7-4 in the semi-finals with a 101.27 average.

Klinge was the story of the tournament. He beat Gian van Veen 6-4 in the quarter-finals and Jonny Clayton 7-5 in the semi-finals, averaging 101.59 and hitting a 170 checkout, the highest of the event. Earlier, Ross Smith had averaged 102.88 against him in the last 16 but still lost.
Klinge's 104.56 in the final was the best average of the tournament.
Wade hit 17 maximums, one more than Klinge, with Price on 12.
